title: Neil Armstrong's Spacecraft Spun Out of Control

lines: In orbit, Neil Armstrong's spacecraft began spinning out of control.
Suddenly, it rolled faster and faster, close to making the crew black out.
They had just docked with a target vehicle.
One of Gemini's own thrusters was stuck on.
Undocking only made the spin faster.
Armstrong used the re-entry thrusters to stop it.
The mission had to end early.
Thruster circuits were redesigned to isolate a single fault.
